# Linear interpolation and flux calculation

```{r}

Drought_Daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Intermediate/Drought_Data_daily.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, par, datetime, value_mean)) %>% 
  separate(datetime, c("date", "Time"), sep = " ") %>% 
  filter(par =="Q") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from ="par", values_from = "value_mean") %>% 
  group_by(site_id, date) %>% 
  mutate(flow_m3ps = Q/11574.1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, date, flow_m3ps) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) 

write_csv(Drought_Daily, "Clean_Data/Intermediate/Drought_Data_daily2.csv")
Water_Chem_select <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Water_Chem_select.csv")
Drought_Daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Intermediate/Drought_Data_daily2.csv")

Water_data <- Water_Chem_select %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, date=Date, Ca_mg_L, Fe_ug_L, DOC_mg_L, TotP_ug_L, TotN_ug_L, NO3_ug_L) 

interp_data <- full_join(Drought_Daily, Water_data) %>% 
  drop_na(flow_m3ps)

# Daily concentrations (linear interpolation)

# 2017
df_2017 <- interp_data %>%
  filter(grepl("2017",date)) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(site_id, date, flow_m3ps, year, month), values_to = "concentrations", names_to = "variable") %>%
  group_by(site_id, variable) %>% 
  mutate(concentrations = na.approx(concentrations, x = date, rule = 2, na.rm = FALSE)) %>% 
  drop_na(concentrations) %>% 
  group_by(site_id, variable, date) %>% 
  mutate(flux = concentrations * flow_m3ps*86400) %>% 
  mutate(flux = ifelse(grepl("mg_L", variable), flux/1000, flux)) %>% 
  mutate(flux = ifelse(grepl("ug_L", variable), flux/1000000, flux)) 

monthly_flux_2017 <- df_2017 %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, variable, flux, year, month)) %>% 
  group_by(site_id, variable, year, month) %>% 
  summarise(monthly_flux = sum(flux, na.rm = TRUE))

annual_flux_2017 <- df_2017 %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, variable, year, flux)) %>% 
  group_by(site_id, variable, year) %>% 
  summarise(annual_flux = sum(flux, na.rm = TRUE))
```

# Annual Flux

```{r}
# Annual Flux
annual_flux_all <- read_csv("Clean_Data/annual_flux_all.csv") %>% 
    mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_ug_L", "")) %>%
    mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_mg_L", ""))

Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, rapportnavn, okoregion, group) 

options(scipen = 99999999)
Plot <- full_join(annual_flux_all, Station_Info) %>% drop_na() %>% 
  filter(group %in% c("'19/'21")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2019", "2021")) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.character(year)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = okoregion, y = annual_flux, fill = year)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape =  NA,alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#3399FF", "#FF8000")) +
  scale_y_log10() + 
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("Annual Flux (Kg)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size =8, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 

ggsave("Figures/Annual_Flux_19_21.pdf", Plot, width = 6, height = 4, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Annual_Flux_19_21.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Annual_Flux_19_21.jpeg")
```

# Q/C Plots

```{r}
# OLD figure----Monthly data. 
Water_Chem_select <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Water_Chem_select.csv")

# Ca
Data <- Water_Chem_select %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date)) %>% 
  mutate(month = month(Date)) %>% 
  mutate(day = day(Date)) %>% 
  mutate(Date = make_date(month, day)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2020")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, Q, Date, year,coniferous_forest, DOC_mg_L, NO3_ug_L, Ca_mg_L)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(col = -c(site_id, Q, Date, year, coniferous_forest), values_to = "measurement", names_to = "Variable")


Plot <- Data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(Q), y = log10(measurement), color = coniferous_forest)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1.0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, color = "blue") +
  facet_grid(Variable ~ year, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("log10(Q)") + ylab("log10(Concentration)")

ggsave("Figures/Q_C.pdf", Plot, width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Q_C.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Q_C.jpeg")
```

# Slope and intercepts

```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(ggstance)

# Daily Concentrations (interpolated and summed back to monthly. 

Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, okoregion)

concentrations_daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/daily_flux_all.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, month, date, year, variable, concentrations) 
  
gwb_q_daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Intermediate/Drought_Data_daily.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, par, datetime, value_mean)) %>% 
  separate(datetime, c("date", "Time"), sep = " ") %>% 
  filter(par =="gwb_q") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from ="par", values_from = "value_mean") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, date, gwb_q) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) 

Data2 <- full_join(concentrations_daily, gwb_q_daily)
Data <- full_join(Data2, Station_Info) %>%  distinct() %>% drop_na()

Plot <- Data %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c("2017", "2022")) %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("DOC_mg_L")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(gwb_q), y = log10(concentrations), color = okoregion)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ year, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("log10(Q)") + ylab("log10(Concentration)")

ggsave("Figures/Q_C_daily.pdf", Plot, width = 6, height = 12, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Q_C_daily.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Q_C_daily.jpeg")



###### By group
Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, rapportnavn, okoregion, group) 

# QC: 2018/2020

concentrations_daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/daily_flux_all.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, date, year, variable, concentrations) %>% 
   filter(year %in% c("2018", "2019", "2020", "2021"))

gwb_q_daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Intermediate/Drought_Data_daily.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, par, datetime, value_mean)) %>% 
  separate(datetime, c("date", "Time"), sep = " ") %>% 
  filter(par =="gwb_q") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from ="par", values_from = "value_mean") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, date, gwb_q) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date, label = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2019", "2020", "2021"))

Data2 <- full_join(concentrations_daily, gwb_q_daily)
Data <- full_join(Data2, Station_Info) %>%  distinct() %>% drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date, label = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter(group %in% c("'18/'20")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2020")) %>% 
  mutate(drought_time =ifelse(grepl("Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr", month), "Before", "After")) %>%
  mutate(drought_time =ifelse(grepl("May|Jun|Jul", month), "During", drought_time)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, date, year, gwb_q, okoregion, variable, concentrations, drought_time)) %>% 
  mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_ug_L", "")) %>%
  mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_mg_L", "")) %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("Ca", "Fe", "DOC", "TotP", "TotN", "NO3"))
  

# Ca
Plot <- Data %>% 
  filter(variable == "Ca_mg_L") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(gwb_q), y = log10(concentrations), color = drought_time)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(year~okoregion, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("log10(Q)") + ylab("log10(Concentration)")

ggsave("Figures/QC_18_20_ca.pdf", Plot, width = 5, height = 4, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/QC_18_20_ca.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/QC_18_20_ca.jpeg")

ggsave("Figures/QC_18_20.pdf", Plot, width = 7, height = 15, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/QC_18_20.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/QC_18_20.jpeg")


# Extract slope and intercepts of Q/C plots. 
Plot <- Data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(gwb_q), y = log10(concentrations), color = drought_time)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(year~variable, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("log10(Q)") + ylab("log10(Concentration)")


# Extract slope and intercept from all plots

Extract_df <- Data %>% 
  group_by(site_id, date, variable) %>% 
  mutate(X = log10(gwb_q), Y = log10(concentrations)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(site_id, year, variable) %>% 
  do({mod = lm(Y ~ X, data =.) 
  data_frame(slope = coef(mod)[2], intercept = coef(mod)[1], r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared)}) 

# Extract slope and intercept from all plots broken down into before, during and after drought. 

Extract_drought_df <- Data %>% 
  group_by(site_id, date, variable) %>% 
  mutate(X = log10(gwb_q), Y = log10(concentrations)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(site_id, year, variable, drought_time) %>% 
  do({mod = lm(Y ~ X, data =.) 
  data_frame(slope = coef(mod)[2], intercept = coef(mod)[1], r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared)})

  group_by(year, okoregion, drought_time, variable) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(matches("slope|intercept")), funs(mean=mean))
```

# Corrplot Slope & intercept

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(fs)
library(lubridate)
library(caret)

Extract_drought_df3 <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Extract_drought.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(slope_mean, intercept_mean, r2)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols= c(slope, intercept), names_to = "Envar", values_to= 'Envar_Measurement') 

Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols= -c(site_id, rapportnavn, fylke, okoregion, group), names_to = "Predict", values_to= 'Predict_Measurement') 

corData <- full_join(Extract_drought_df3, Station_Info) %>% drop_na()

data_nest <- corData %>% group_by(group, okoregion, year, variable, Envar,Predict) %>% nest() 
str(slice(data_nest, 1))
cor_fun <- function(data) cor.test(data$Envar_Measurement, data$Predict_Measurement, method = "pearson", adjust = "bonferroni") %>% tidy() #bonferroni
data_nest <- mutate(data_nest, model = map(data, cor_fun))
str(slice(data_nest, 1))
corr_pr <- dplyr::select(data_nest, -data) %>% unnest()
corr_pr <- mutate(corr_pr, sig = ifelse(p.value <0.05, "Sig.", "Non Sig."))


corr_pr_18 <- corr_pr %>% 
  filter(group %in% c("'18/'20")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018","2020")) %>% 
  drop_na(estimate)

corr_pr_18$Predict <- factor(corr_pr_18$Predict, levels = c("other", "woodland_scrub", "agriculture", "mixed_forest", "coniferous_forest", "water_bodies", "peat_bogs", "glacier", "sparse_vegetation", "moors_and_heathland", "bare_rocks", "broad_leaved_forest", "longitude","latitude","min_2018_gwb_sssrel","mean_annual_gwb_sssrel", "mean_annual_gwb_q", "sum_annual_rr", "mean_annual_tm", "mean_slope", "mean_elevation", "area_km2"), labels = c("other", "woodland_scrub", "agriculture", "mixed_forest", "coniferous_forest", "water_bodies", "peat_bogs", "glacier", "sparse_vegetation", "moors_and_heathland", "bare_rocks", "broad_leaved_forest", "longitude","latitude","min_2018_gwb_sssrel","m_an_gwb_sssrel", "m_an_gwb_q", "sum_an_rr", "m_an_tm", "m_slope", "m_elevation", "area_km2"))

corr_pr_19 <- corr_pr %>% 
  filter(group %in% c("'19/'21")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2019","2021")) %>% 
  drop_na(estimate)

corr_pr_19$Predict <- factor(corr_pr_19$Predict, levels = c("other", "woodland_scrub", "agriculture", "mixed_forest", "coniferous_forest", "water_bodies", "peat_bogs", "glacier", "sparse_vegetation", "moors_and_heathland", "bare_rocks", "broad_leaved_forest", "longitude","latitude","min_2018_gwb_sssrel","mean_annual_gwb_sssrel", "mean_annual_gwb_q", "sum_annual_rr", "mean_annual_tm", "mean_slope", "mean_elevation", "area_km2"), labels = c("other", "woodland_scrub", "agriculture", "mixed_forest", "coniferous_forest", "water_bodies", "peat_bogs", "glacier", "sparse_vegetation", "moors_and_heathland", "bare_rocks", "broad_leaved_forest", "longitude","latitude","min_2018_gwb_sssrel","m_an_gwb_sssrel", "m_an_gwb_q", "sum_an_rr", "m_an_tm", "m_slope", "m_elevation", "area_km2"))

corr_pr_ALL <- corr_pr %>% 
  filter(group %in% c("'18/'19/'20/'21")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018","2019", "2020","2021")) %>% 
  drop_na(estimate)

  geom_tile(data = filter(corr_slope_18, sig == "Sig."),
```

```{r}
# Mean monthly standardized stream flow. 
# subtract mean and divide by SD. 

Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, rapportnavn, okoregion, group) 

flow_daily <- read_csv("Clean_Data/daily_flux_all.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, month, date, year, flow_m3ps) 

Data <- full_join(flow_daily, Station_Info) %>%  distinct() %>% drop_na() %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c("2017", "2022")) %>% 
  group_by(rapportnavn, date) %>% 
  mutate(flow_m3ps = flow_m3ps * 86400) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(rapportnavn, year, month) %>% 
  mutate(flow_m3ps = mean(flow_m3ps)) %>%  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(rapportnavn, year) %>% 
  summarise(group = group, site_id = site_id, okoregion = okoregion,date = date, flow_m3ps = flow_m3ps, mean = mean(flow_m3ps), sd=sd(flow_m3ps)) %>% 
  mutate(flow_m3ps_sd = (flow_m3ps - mean)/sd)

# All stations
Plot <- Data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month(date, label=TRUE, abbr=TRUE), y = flow_m3ps_sd, group = factor(year(date)), color = factor(year(date)))) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~rapportnavn, ncol =3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size =8, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Month") + labs(color ="year")

ggsave("Figures/standard_flow.pdf", Plot, width = 6, height = 15, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/standard_flow.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/standard_flow.jpeg")


# By group

Plot1 <- Data %>% 
  filter(group == "'18/'20") %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2020")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month(date, label=TRUE, abbr=TRUE), y = flow_m3ps_sd, group = factor(year(date)), color = factor(year(date)))) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#FFCC66", "#264EFF")) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~rapportnavn, ncol =3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size =8, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Month") + labs(color ="year") + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Standardized flow")


Plot2 <- Data %>% 
  filter(group == "'19/'21") %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2019", "2021")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month(date, label=TRUE, abbr=TRUE), y = flow_m3ps_sd, group = factor(year(date)), color = factor(year(date)))) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.05) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#3399FF", "#FF8000")) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~rapportnavn, ncol =3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size =8, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Month") + labs(color ="year") + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Standardized flow")

Plot3 <- Data %>% 
  filter(group == "'18/'19/'20/'21") %>%
```

# Cluster flow curves

```{r}
##### Cluster flow curves
library(kmlShape)

Data2 <- Data %>% 
  unite("ID", rapportnavn:year, sep = "_", remove = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, month, flow_m3ps_sd) %>% distinct()

Data2 <- as.data.frame(Data2)
myClds = cldsLong(Data2)
parKmlShape(aggregationMethod="hierarchical")
kmlShape(myClds, nbClusters = 3, timeScale = 0.1, 
         FrechetSumOrMax ="max", toPlot="both", parAlgo=parKmlShape())

clusters <- as.data.frame(myClds["clusters"])

par(ask=FALSE)
plot(myClds)


### five clusters
Data2 <- Data %>% 
  unite("ID", rapportnavn:year, sep = "_", remove = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, month, flow_m3ps_sd) %>% distinct()

Data2 <- as.data.frame(Data2)
myClds = cldsLong(Data2)
parKmlShape(aggregationMethod="hierarchical")
kmlShape(myClds, nbClusters = 5, timeScale = 0.1, 
         FrechetSumOrMax ="max", toPlot="both", parAlgo=parKmlShape())

clusters2 <- as.data.frame(myClds["clusters"]) %>% 
  mutate(cluster = myClds["clusters"]) %>% 
  mutate(ID = row.names(.))

par(ask=FALSE)

plot(myClds)

#Clusters <- clusters2 %>% 
#  mutate(cluster =ifelse(grepl("3|4", myClds["clusters"]), 3, myClds["clusters"])) %>% 
#  mutate(cluster =ifelse(grepl("5", myClds["clusters"]), 4, cluster)) %>% 
#  mutate(ID = row.names(.))

Data3 <- Data %>% 
  unite("ID", rapportnavn:year, sep = "_", remove = F, na.rm = FALSE) 
Data4 <- full_join(Data3, clusters2)

Plot <- Data4 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month(date, label=TRUE, abbr=TRUE), y = flow_m3ps_sd)) + 
  geom_line(aes(group = factor(ID), color = factor(cluster)), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(group = factor(ID), color = factor(cluster)), size = 0.03, alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = cluster), fun.y=mean, colour="black", geom="line", size = 1.4) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, ncol = 1) +
  xlab("Month") + ylab("standardized flow") + labs(color ="year") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size =6, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))  +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("Figures/standard_flow_cluster1.pdf", Plot, width = 3, height = 8, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/standard_flow_cluster1.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/standard_flow_cluster1.jpeg")
```

```{r}
library(ggspatial)
library("rnaturalearth")
library("rnaturalearthdata")
library(RColorBrewer)

# river station coordinates
Station_Info <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Station_Info.csv") 

X <- full_join(Station_Info, Data4) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, latitude, longitude, cluster)) %>% distinct() %>% drop_na()


stations_cord <- st_as_sf(X, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "WGS84", remove = FALSE) 
stations_cord = st_transform(stations_cord, "EPSG:25833")

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
class(world)

map <- ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(3.1611, 32.000), ylim = c(57.000, 72.000), expand = FALSE) +
  layer_spatial(stations_cord, aes(col = factor(cluster)), xlim = c(0.0611, 32.000), ylim = c(57.000, 72.000)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(3.1611, 32.000), ylim = c(57.000, 72.000), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + labs(color ="flow regime")

ggsave("Figures/map_clusters.pdf", map, width = 4, height = 5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/map_clusters.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)

p <- (map|Plot) + plot_layout(ncol=2,widths=c(2.3,0.7), heights =c(1,1))
```
